caveat: Synthetic stand-in corpus. Its phone durations are drawn uniformly on [60, 140] ms, so boundaries are quasi-regular and evenly spaced guesses at the reference rate score well. The uniform baseline is therefore far stronger here than on real speech, and no learned detector on this corpus should be read as a statement about T3.
